   **Pricing and paywall.**

      Review window: Sep 8, 2026 - Sep 15, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Erin Love_, Sep 15, 2026, 1/5: "I have canceled my subscription through Google Play. Store, as the app requires you to do. And I'm still being charged month after month. Getting to customer service, there's no easy way. How some of the reviews on here are so high, It's unbelievable. There's no easy way to cancel your account. The only way I can see is to cancel the account through google play service and then turn around and block each and every charge."
            2. _Arlene Mingils_, Sep 14, 2026, 1/5: "Not clear on pricing! Beware ⚠️. I never received an answer on how much I was being charged!! I was just told that they would cancel my subscription 😡"
